incidents.name: Rikkei Finance SimplePriceOracle setOracleData access control
incidents.notes: SimplePriceOracle.setOracleData() had no access control, letting the attacker point the rBNB feed at their own latestRoundData() contract and borrow the whole protocol against a 1e10-times inflated rBNB collateral value.

sources.ref: onchain review: SimplePriceOracle 0xD55f01B4B51B7F48912cD8Ca3CDD8070A1a9DBa5 created 2022-02-17T17:42:15Z by 0xedf1acba4396cfc98483fd25769df48926771d54, unrelated to attack sender 0x803e0930357ba577dc414b552402f71656c093ab; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Transfer flows in the exploit tx show ~346k USDC, ~297k USDT, ~300k BUSD and 3.03 BTCB leaving the rToken markets, consistent with the reported ~$1.1M.
